queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS avg_all FROM compliancecase
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT casestat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY casestat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.casestat, s.avg_conf, s.avg_conf - o.avg_all AS above_avg
  FROM status_avg s, overall o
  WHERE s.avg_conf > o.avg_all
)
SELECT casestat, avg_conf, above_avg,
       avg_conf / (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM qualifying) AS ratio
FROM qualifying;
SELECT casestat,
       AVG(risksc) AS avg_risksc,
       (AVG(risksc) - (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase)) / (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase) * 100 AS pct_above_overall
FROM compliancecase
GROUP BY casestat
HAVING AVG(risksc) > (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase);
SELECT casestat, AVG(risksc) / (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase) AS ratio FROM compliancecase GROUP BY casestat
WITH g AS (
  SELECT casestat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY casestat
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_avg FROM g
),
q AS (
  SELECT g.casestat, g.avg_conf, g.avg_conf - m.mean_avg AS distance
  FROM g, m
  WHERE g.avg_conf > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT casestat, avg_conf, distance, avg_conf / (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM q) AS ratio
FROM q;
SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(risksc) AS avg_risksc
FROM compliancecase
GROUP BY brokrepstat
HAVING AVG(risksc) > (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase WHERE brokrepstat IS NOT NULL);
